title: MaasStudio Guest Check-in
description: A multilingual guest-registration app with guided pre-arrival check-in, document-assisted entry, and an administrative visit workspace.
body:
MaasStudio Guest Check-in is a guest-registration application. It connects a guided multilingual pre-arrival flow with an administrative workspace for reviewing visits.

## What it does

The application supports document-assisted data entry and gives guests access to practical arrival information and local guides. Administrators can inspect visit details without working through disconnected forms.

## Recent work

Late September work made core application flows independent of optional email configuration, while an unconfigured send still fails explicitly. Document-image deletion now preserves deletion evidence and prevents deleted images from being exposed through normal application reads. This does not mean every identifying record is erased or that the workflow is certified compliant.

September work integrated document recognition into the registration flow, added scheduled identity-image cleanup, improved visit-detail routing and date handling, and bundled guest information with the application.

## Current boundary

This remains a development project. Legal and privacy questions around identity-image collection require resolution before relying on that workflow in production. The project is not presented as a compliance certification.
